def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # Locate the bounding box of the enclosing 5-colored frame.
    rs=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if 5 in row]
    r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs)
    cs=[c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if any(grid[r][c]==5 for r in range(len(grid)))]
    c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
    # Build alternating one-cell nested bands, leaving the central 3x3 empty.
    k=1
    while r0+k < r1-k and c0+k < c1-k and (r1-r0-2*k+1)>3 and (c1-c0-2*k+1)>3:
        color=2 if k%2==1 else 5
        for r in range(r0+k,r1-k+1):
            out[r][c0+k]=color; out[r][c1-k]=color
        for c in range(c0+k,c1-k+1):
            out[r0+k][c]=color; out[r1-k][c]=color
        k+=1
    return out
